top_signals.title: US Stock Futures Rise on Anthropic, Aussie Drops: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US equity-index futures rose while Asian shares fell as traders assessed whether Anthropic PBC’s record initial public offering can revive confidence in the artificial intelligence trade following a recent selloff in technology stocks. The Australian dollar weakened.
